title: Mounted binds the current Sprint follower as one actor

verification.actor: Prepared FOLLOWER Stantler234, party slot2 PID2920357538, becomes the same current MOUNTED actor.
verification.trigger: Prepare the Sprint Stantler, start it as the current follower, then mount it with bounded read-only getter and Begin observations.
verification.observable: Begin receives the Mounted profile, not the Follower-only profile. The resolver parity scenario separately proves normal Owner field and primitive inheritance. Mounted keeps a distinct policy fingerprint, stores its Begin Owner bytes, and the same final actor owns input.

setupMutations.change: Copy test.nds and test.sav. Replace party slot2 with level5 Stantler using the fixed native party operation.
Start that exact Stantler as Follower, then mount it with owner-transfer diagnostics. Read the Follower getter and separate Mounted Begin values; retain all scoped receipts and cleanup.

limits: Prepared byte-transfer proof only. No normal Y/Select input, Hop completion, movement timing, full resolver provenance or soak claim.
One observed frame proves final identity and ownership only. The separate mount.begin-current-follower input-and-Hop requirement remains open.

events.value: Prepare and start the Sprint Stantler follower, then mount that same subject through the prepared lifecycle.
Require separate Follower and Mounted profile inputs, distinct policy identity, matching stored Mounted Owner bytes, and one completed mounted frame.

stop.condition: One complete profile transfer and final bound frame, or first missing/invalid observation.

invariants: Mounted uses its own forced system profile identity
